newsitem.title: PERU: Peru congress committee passes gov't budget bills.
newsitem.headline: Peru congress committee passes gov't budget bills.

text.p: The Peruvian Congress' budget committee approved on Wednesday two key bills that form part of the government's 1997 budget legislation package.

The committee voted through a bill allowing the government to contract $1.8 billion new debt in 1997, down from $2 billion in 1996 and another measure outlining the state's sources of income to sustain next year's spending plans.

The government has proposed a 24.765 billion sol 1997 spending budget, nominally higher than this year's 22.263 billion soles, but lower in real terms when taking into account estimated 1996 inflation of about 12 percent.
The government-dominated Congress is expected to approve the bills by a November 30 deadline.
